note: Moved from plans/voice-guitar-advanced-first-week.json, day 2. Marked a warm-up (DayShape2, 2026-11-24): a whole 5-minute warm-up for an advanced singer, part 1 of the voice run; its choice names no step now. The text is unchanged, so the versions are too.

cells.text: Start the lip roll below: a tone slides up and back down, then you make the same slide on your own while the mic draws your line. Sing it on a lip roll, and keep the buzz the same size at the top as at the bottom.

Start the hill below and hold an easy hum: the ball rolls down into the hollow as your voice goes low, and the ring fills while you stay there. Each hold is a semitone lower, with the new note played in the breath between.
Keep it quiet: a low note pushed for volume goes flat.
